Town & meters

Town

The seed, street source and house count define your town.

This town comes from an engine snapshot.

Generate builds a new town (a new town id) from your edits; house styles, trees and landmarks are repeatable visual details, and customer data keeps its own identifiers.

Town generator

Same seed + size = same town.

Same master seed + settings + generator version = the same town, byte for byte. A new seed is random but shown here, so you can type it again later. The other seeds (under Seeds) re-roll one part of the town and keep the rest.

No changes from this town

Process & costs

Run settings

How reads fail, what VEE flags, who works the queues and what it costs. These settings apply to the engine run of this town (no regeneration); the worklists replay the year with them.

Scenario

Operations day

How the operations day runs: crews, response times, back-feed limits, leaks and reading rounds. Changes apply to the next run of the map's day; the town and its customers stay the same.

Engine defaults.

Incident frequency

Frequency controls will be enabled when the engine provides its configuration schema and update endpoint.

Engine & data

Use the browser demo or load a town snapshot and its state frames.

Town & meters edits the town itself and generates a new town with a new town id. Process & costs edits this town's meter-to-cash run. Scenario edits the operations day on the map. Nothing in this section changes the town.
